Sign-language inventory thesis: sociolinguistics, generational transmission, Swadesh-list lexicon, iconicity, numerals/time signs, interrogatives, pronouns (ch. 8, esp. 8.6.1 'Questoes linguisticas preliminares sobre a Lingua de Sinais de Caicara', pp. 193ff). Only general remarks on sign-language phonology (Stokoe parameters) in ch. 2; no prosody/stress for Caicara SL. Word stress in the spoken-language sense is not applicable.
